goal: Fixed seven full-LLM workloads: minimize total makespan versus measured native NVIDIA MPS. No other concurrency counts.
selection: Minimum pilot makespan; static caps larger wins tie; phase100 is diagnostic only; choose phase90 or phase75 by minimum makespan,90 wins tie. Freeze beforeholdouts.
policy: Per-client walltime credits: decode/idle100%; prefill90/75% only while any worker decodes. Debt retained, WC off. Credits are not exclusive GPU time; phase sampling is not kernel preemption.
window: Commonrelease after identical loading/warmup, to latest final token completion amongall7; include drain.
scope: Isolated experimentnamespace only. Keep operating queues/tenants/controllers/driver/MIG unchanged. No git upload.
